behaviour_contract: Normal textures pack full tiles in288-byte records and mixed tiles in544-byte records, including transparency masks and two-bit row flags. Atlas tile0 is special, and counting stops at the first all-zero tile. Preserve the source's exact boundary comparisons when classifying texture records. Visible rectangle coordinates include partial tiles; tile_index narrows to16bits and tile counts to8bits. Draw alignment displacement is4-(x&3), giving1..4. Camera/scroll clamping includes bias8, small-map behavior and two locked-scroll level exceptions. Odd-width scrolling-sprite allocation behavior is an observed DOS quirk, not a new valid-input guarantee.
